Canon EF 50mm f/1.8 STM

The nifty fifty — the cheapest way into tracked Milky Way shots.

around $125

Canon's legendary budget prime: f/1.8 aperture gathers ~8x more light than a kit lens at 50mm. Pair it with a star tracker and a Canon body for sharp, cheap wide-field nightscapes.

Why we like it

  • f/1.8 gathers huge amounts of light for the price
  • Sharp stopped down, tiny, light
  • The classic first astro lens on Canon

Keep in mind

  • 50mm is wide — deep-sky targets stay small
  • Plastic build, basic manual focus ring
  • EF mount — RF shooters need an adapter
